identity.name: Perpetual Calendar
identity.one_liner: A 1940s-styled perpetual calendar — cream lacquer dial, syringe hands, triple-stepped lugs — on a current automatic caliber.

narrative.story: The 5320G of 2017 is Patek quoting its own archive: cream lacquered dial, luminous syringe hands and baton markers pulled from mid-century references like the 1591, day-month apertures under 12 and analog date with moonphase at 6, all on the automatic 324 S Q. The triple-stepped lugs are the detail collectors fixate on. A blue-dial 5320G-011 joined later.
narrative.collector_notes: This is the entry point into current-production Patek perpetuals and trades closer to retail than the sports references. Lacquer dials show edge cracks around apertures with age — inspect under magnification.
